Two widths of cloth joined together and decorated.

A long rectangular piece of cream cotton. It is embroidered with geometric patterns in grey along the two long edges; it is woven with pink and grey stripes towards one short edge, with geometric embroidery in grey in between the stripes.

Woven cotton cloth, white background with red and orange stripes down long edges, both short edges with two stripes of black then stitched rectangular shapes followed by a series of red lines with lines of black geometric patterns including zigzags and diamond shapes.

A large rectangular cloth of cream cotton, possibly a body cloth. It is made from two large rectangles of cream cotton cloth that have been folded lengthways and sewn together.  Towards one end, the cloth is woven with thick red stripes and one thick blue stripe; the is geometric embroidery in dark blue between the red stripes, and thin double stripes running towards the edge.

Woven cotton cloth, rectangular in shape, white background, stripes of orange and red running down long edges, short ends with two black lines and short dotted lines meeting them perpendicularly, closer to the centre are lines of red and orange with zigzags and geometric patterns in blue.

Pukuru putkuli. A woman's body cloth made from two large rectangles of cream cotton cloth that have been folded lengthways and sewn together. One cloth is woven with thick red stripes that have been embroidered with geometric patterns in black, and one thick blue stripe towards one end with stripes of black embroidery running towards the edge; the other cloth is woven with blue and red stripes towards one end.
A rectangular cloth made from two panels of cream cotton sewn together. The cotton is woven with red and grey stripes, and embroidered with a diamond pattern in dark blue.

A rectangular piece of cloth made from two pieces of white cotton textile stitched together, both woven with vertical thin grey stripes and horizontally with thick pink and grey stripes along the top. It is embroidered with rectangular panels of geometric pattern in grey and pink threads. The edges are stitched over on two corners.

A rectangular cloth made from multiple panels of cream cotton sewn together. There are wide grey and red woven stripes, and embroidery in dark blue, including double vertical stripes of small square stitches along the top, and bands of geometric pattern and zig-zags. A rectangular section has been cut from one edge.

Male funerary ornament. Band of cotton fabric with white floral designs on maroon background, bordered with blue blanket stitch. From base of band hangs ten large discs from strands of red wool, possibly acrylic, discs with a blue background sewn in blue thread and embellished with beads, probably glass, of silver, green and blue arranged in geometric patterns. Two smaller discs hang from one of the short edges.

Female's funerary ornament, cuboid in shape, inner part covered in white cotton sewn with blue thread, this is then wrapped with blue wool string in a pattern forming concentric squares on bottom and top faces, reddish pink twine is wrapped above the blue forming squares with a cross on side faces. At the centre of the top face is a round flat disc embellished with strings of beads in silver and blue, probably glass, on each corner of the cube is a flat disc with the same glass or plastic blue and silver beads, and from the base, two more beaded discs hang from reddish pink thread, discs are sewn on with green thread.

Male funerary ornament. Armlet or bracelet of core wrapped in red and dark blue twine, decorated with red faceted gems, possibly coloured glass, encircled by small bronze coloured seed beads, probably glass. Attached to the circlet is a large disc ornament, made of plant fibre, possibly cane, wrapped in blue thread and embellished with beads, probably glass, of silver, green, yellow and blue arranged in a geometric pattern.

Male funerary ornament. Two small disc ornaments, made of plant fibre, possibly cane, wrapped in dark blue cotton threads, connected by long strands of purple wool, wrapped in pink cotton thread at disc attachment point. Discs embellished with bronze coloured beads, probably glass.

Male funerary ornament. Two woollen bobbles or pom-poms, one green with magenta centre, one magenta with green centre, ornamented with two sets of two grey beads, probably glass, connected by length of black woollen twine.
